title: Bernardo Silva Joins Real Madrid and Debuts in LaLiga
seoTitle: Bernardo Silva Debuts for Real Madrid in LaLiga
subtitle: Portuguese midfielder completes the club's new phase and already plays against Espanyol
excerpt: Bernardo Silva signed with Real Madrid, dons number 20, and debuts in the second LaLiga round against Espanyol, with the favorites seeking three points.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The announcement of Bernardo Silva’s signing by Real Madrid sparked online searches, as the Portuguese player reached the club he has idolized since childhood. The midfielder signed the contract in front of Florentino Pérez and is ready for the first official match of the season.

Contract and Dream Realized

Bernardo Silva signed the official contract on Wednesday, holding the number 20 shirt before posing for photos. In statements to the club, the Portuguese said he has always dreamed of wearing Real Madrid’s shirt and that he is "truly, very, very happy."

First LaLiga Match

Bernardo Silva’s official debut takes place on Saturday, August 22, when Real Madrid visits the RCDE Stadium to face Espanyol in the second round of the 2026/27 LaLiga season. The match starts at 16:30 Brasília time and will be broadcast live in Brazil by CTV.

Recent Statistics of the Opponents

Real Madrid arrives at the match with 80% unbeaten in the last five away fixtures, averaging 1.40 goals scored and 0.60 conceded. In the last season, the team recorded 14 wins in 21 official matches. Espanyol, meanwhile, won its first league game 3-0 against Levante, maintaining 100% home unbeaten in the last five home fixtures.

Favoritism and Expected Result

Calculated odds point to a 66% chance of victory for Real Madrid, 22% for a draw, and 12% for Espanyol’s win. The head‑to‑head record reinforces the favoritism: in the last ten matches between the teams, Real Madrid won eight, Espanyol two, and there were no draws.

Impact of Silva’s Arrival

With Bernardo Silva’s inclusion, Real Madrid’s midfield gains more creativity and game control. Coach José Mourinho can rely on the Portuguese’s mobility alongside Vinícius Júnior and Kylian Mbappé, expanding offensive options and strengthening possession, which averages 61.6% in recent matches.

Information from SBT News, ogol.com.br, OneFootball.
